new_application_judgments.judgment: The whole bounded-above removable extension proof5.23 and psh version5.24 apply locally to r+chi off the analytic divisor, with a common upper bound from v<=psi+C. Positivity of eta+ddc r then follows from its positive off-divisor restriction and the positive matrix-measure restriction on the divisor; smooth correction assigns the divisor zero measure. The whole5.7 proof via4.23/4.24 establishes the upper-envelope property; freezing the smooth background makes the envelope retain the exact lower bound. Only the source local psh theorem is invoked, with positive operator rescaling.

Lemma1.2 and its whole local proof supply maximum/contact for bounded eta-psh functions. The application takes max(r,-j) at a fixed level below the bounded floor, then uses exact finite-level locality on its residual branch; all contact potentials are bounded. Source passages suggesting global exact smooth Hermitian approximation are not used: a common local closed strict correction, fixed-background expansion and the source local maximum proof suffice. No arbitrary unbounded monotone continuity is inferred.

The new residual eta is smooth strictly positive. A sufficiently negative constant is a strict barrier on all X, so Section4 Theorem4.5 applies to nonzero bounded g_sigma=exp(sigma psi)f, although it vanishes on the divisor. For Lemma4.2 both residuals compared are bounded, their difference is bounded, and the measure ratio is the strict constant exp(-sigma epsilon). Neither BMP nor global singular strict-domination is required. Positive dd-c rescaling preserves the applications; the two older v1 typos are unused.

Continuous residual potentials and continuous complex Hessian use bounded local recursion after a common quadratic correction; uniform mollified complex Hessians identify ordinary squares. Divisor removal follows from the actual non-pluripolar definition. Closed curve bounded truncations have total mass a and bound the unbounded non-pluripolar mass; the full-mass sandwich then identifies the entire distributional current. No arbitrary nonclosed critical uniqueness is asserted.

scope: All fixed compact Hermitian second factors, specified varying logarithmic ordinary models and continuous factored data. Broad S05 remains open.
generalized_application_judgment: All BGL and bounded BT/maximum/removable prerequisites apply in complex dimension N=k+1, with eta smooth strictly positive, a constant strict barrier, bounded nonzero g_sigma and a strict comparison ratio. The other factor is any fixed smooth positive Hermitian kappa, not assumed closed or BMP. Curve restrictions are justified after the exact horizontal FS correction plus a large vertical quadratic; every slice is psh or identically polar. The model envelope upper bound therefore requires no transitive Y symmetry. Actual top products permit exactly one horizontal factor, yielding N b^k A dW. The closed-curve mass sandwich and harmonic uniqueness remain entirely on P1. The explicit Hopf factor descends under z->2z, polar topology gives b1=1 and the compact-Kahler even-b1 obstruction supplies the separate non-Kahler example; it is not an additional analytic selection premise.
